answer: Sybil farms fail a sparse interferometry gate. An applicant stakes 13.2 POA and holds three radio-quiet slots, 170km apart, for 9 hours. Each slot records a 64-second tone; the network publishes only the hash, and the station must return an echo of that tone plus its clock offset. Residual delay delta across the tapes must sit between 0.54ms and 2.8ms per 100km; tighter clustering burns 2.1 POA as co-sited. Mid-watch, a gale of 120 forged tones is injected; answering more than one forged hash voids the stake. A dead slot after 40 minutes refunds 10.4 POA and parks the applicant for 60 hours.
